kind: one-shot synthetic integration construction; no live allocation
hypothesis: A typed health observation that crosses an authored V39 cover floor while a planner answer is pending is composed into verified executor cancellation before planner interrupt transport; the invalidated answer stays ineligible. A soft change within the floor preserves the policy and does not cancel.
test: Use current-main build_cover_monitor and DoomCoverSignalPairMonitor with source health 100 and critical floor 80; evaluate health 84 at authored maximum-loss limits 12 (hard crossing) and 16 (soft change), then pass actual hard invalidation through current cancel_invalidated_cover and PersistentPlannerAdapter with deterministic in-process fakes. Include executor cancel-write failure.
decision: PASS_CONSTRUCTION_COMPOSITION only if hard crossing triggers cancel-before-interrupt, verified empty terminal is required, stale answer is rejected even after completion, cancel-write failure still attempts planner interruption and remains an error, and soft change preserves the pending turn without cancellation.
counterhypothesis: Monitor wiring, callback ordering, or planner lifecycle may fail to connect the health invalidation to local cancellation and stale-answer rejection.
uncertainty: Synthetic typed observations and fake transports do not establish real HUD extraction timing, actual App Server behavior, physical key release, useful feedback, recovery, survival, or task effect.
retry_policy: Execute the candidate once after this freeze. Do not repeat a live allocation or change the frozen candidate after observing its outcome.
